description: Evaluation cases for the pharma domain pack, run against the synthetic Ardley Park corpus in sample-documents/pharma.

cases.question: Is manufacturing Line 2 ready for the next batch of Product PX-200?
cases.notes: An open deviation, an overdue CAPA, and an unresolved SOP revision conflict all bear on Line 2. Readiness must never be reported as SUPPORTED.

cases.question: Which deviations or CAPAs remain unresolved?
cases.notes: Both are open; CAPA-2026-019 is overdue. Multi-document retrieval across two record types.

cases.question: Are there conflicting SOP revisions for equipment cleaning on Line 2?
cases.notes: SOP-CL-004 Rev 3 (72h hold, 6 swabs) and Rev 4 (120h hold, 4 swabs) are both effective and neither is superseded.

cases.question: What cleaning validation evidence supports a 120-hour clean hold time?
cases.notes: VP-CL-2024-09 validates only to 72 hours. SOP-CL-004 Rev 4 cites an Addendum 1 that does not exist in the corpus — the deliberate missing-evidence case.

cases.question: What is the assay result for batch PX-200-2607?
mustNotMention: assay result for batch px-200-2607 is
cases.notes: No such batch exists in the corpus. The system must abstain rather than infer a result from the PX-200-2604 record. Citations are permitted and desirable here: quoting the 2604 record to demonstrate it is a different batch is stronger evidence of a correct abstention than citing nothing at all.

cases.question: Are there open change controls affecting Line 2 equipment qualification?
cases.notes: CC-2026-011 is open and is the root of the SOP revision conflict.

cases.question: What must quality personnel verify before batch PX-200-2604 can be reviewed for release?
cases.notes: Analytical and microbiological release testing are outstanding. The answer must not read as performing or pre-empting the QP's assessment.
